children.title: Append Editor
children.description: Append to your notes. Write GitHub Flavored Markdown via four different editing modes: Plain Textarea with spell check, in-line formatting provided by CodeMirror, what-you-see-is-what-you-get live formatting provided by the Rich Markdown Editor developed by Outline, and in-line syntax highlighting provided by the Monaco Editor. In addition to GFM, the Plain Textarea, CodeMirror, and Monaco modes support KaTeX, table of contents, footnotes, in-line HTML, and emoji codes. The Monaco mode also supports autocompletion, search and replace, and syntax highlighting for over 60 programming languages. The Append Editor has built-in support for printing notes and per-note font sizes, font families, and custom CSS.

repo_info.description: Append to your notes @StandardNotes with GitHub Flavored Markdown via CodeMirror, Rich Markdown, and Monaco
